queries.query: जमशेदपुर शहर जमीन का नक्शा टाटा लीज वार्ड प्लॉट भूमि रिकॉर्ड आधिकारिक
queries.scope: Find city-specific land plot schedules and any public parcel geometry for Jamshedpur.
queries.result: The East Singhbhum District Administration publishes a Tata Lease agreement and separate Ward 1–19 land schedules. The Ward 1 schedule is a textual plot/area listing (Khata 622) rather than a georeferenced polygon service. The district land-records page links the State Jharkhand revenue portal. The WUP point was not resolved to a Tata lease ward or cadastral plot; no full geometry was obtained.
queries.executionMethod: Hindi-language search followed by official East Singhbhum pages and Ward schedule PDF inspection; attempted direct navigation to the official state records route.

queries.query: Jamshedpur official land records Tata lease ward plot schedules cadastral map Jharkhand
queries.scope: Cross-check English primary evidence for city plots and public geometry.
queries.result: The District Administration’s official Tata Lease page links a formal lease agreement and plot schedules by city ward (plot number and area), establishing city-specific land/lease records. The state Jharbhoomi link is listed on the district land-records page, but its live page did not return a response through the current network path. No public full-polygon endpoint or WUP-point plot lookup was verified.
queries.executionMethod: English query plus official district land-records and Tata Lease page inspection; linked state portal direct request timed out before HTTP response.
